# Built In

> Built In is a tech job search platform and employer branding solution connecting talent with innovative companies across the US.

Built In operates both a job seeker platform (builtin.com) featuring tech and startup job listings, company profiles, and salary data, and a B2B recruitment marketing solution (employers.builtin.com) for companies to attract engineering talent. The platform covers diverse tech sectors including healthtech, fintech, blockchain, and AI.

## Key Topics

- Tech Jobs
- Job Search
- Company Profiles
- Remote Work
- Engineering Roles
- Salaries & Compensation
- Company Culture
- Startup Jobs
- Recruitment Marketing
- Perks & Benefits
- Healthtech
- Fintech
- Blockchain
- Artificial Intelligence
- Career Development

## Job Search & Listings

- [Best Tech Jobs & Startup Jobs 2026](https://builtin.com/jobs): Main tech and startup job listings search interface with daily updates
- [Best Remote Tech Jobs 2026](https://builtin.com/jobs/remote): Filtered job listings for remote tech positions across companies and startups

## Company Research & Profiles

- [Top Tech Companies 2026](https://builtin.com/companies): Directory of tech companies with profiles, benefits, and hiring information
- [Doximity Careers, Perks + Culture](https://builtin.com/company/doximity): Doximity company profile with careers, culture, and benefits information
- [Coinbase Careers, Perks + Culture](https://builtin.com/company/coinbase): Coinbase cryptocurrency fintech company profile and career information
- [PEAK6 Careers, Perks + Culture](https://builtin.com/company/peak6): PEAK6 fintech investment firm profile with culture and benefits details
- [SOPHiA GENETICS Careers, Perks + Culture](https://builtin.com/company/sophia-genetics): SOPHiA GENETICS healthtech biotech company profile and career details
- [Best Places to Work in 2026](https://builtin.com/awards/us/2026/best-places-to-work): Algorithmic rankings of startups and tech companies by employee benefits

## Company Job Openings

- [Doximity Jobs + Careers](https://builtin.com/company/doximity/jobs): Job listings and career opportunities at Doximity healthtech company
- [Coinbase Jobs + Careers](https://builtin.com/company/coinbase/jobs): Coinbase job listings for blockchain and AI engineering roles
- [PEAK6 Jobs + Careers](https://builtin.com/company/peak6/jobs): Job listings for PEAK6 fintech roles in Austin and Chicago offices
- [SOPHiA GENETICS Jobs + Careers](https://builtin.com/company/sophia-genetics/jobs): SOPHiA GENETICS job listings for AI and biotech engineering roles

## Compensation & Career Resources

- [US Tech Salaries 2026](https://builtin.com/salaries): Salary database with compensation data for US tech jobs and positions

## Recruitment Solutions

- [Built In For Employers](https://employers.builtin.com): Built In's B2B product for recruitment marketing and employer branding
